name: print-social-glowing-ghost-child-over-1940s-new-york-street-illustration
title: Painterly 1940s New York street at dusk with a glowing ghost child floating above the bridge
whatItIs: A tall digital painting of a 1940s city street: art-deco skyscrapers, a stone bridge tower, an elevated walkway, vintage cars, a 'Starlite Diner' sign, figures in hats, wet pavement reflections and a luminous ghostly child with a kite floating in the starry sky.
whatItMeans: Nostalgic and magical; warm streetlight and one glowing figure turn a realistic scene into a quiet fairytale.
techniques: Make one element the only light-emitting subject.
Use warm streetlight against cool night for depth.
Frame the focal point with tall buildings as leading lines.
Add small human figures for scale and story.

vocabulary.definition: Lines in a composition that guide the eye to the subject.
The main light source that defines the mood.
